Its ENNReal lower integrals preserve the source's permitted infinite case, and restricting Lebesgue volume to (0,∞) represents the same integral from 0 to infinity up to the null endpoint.

Those cases are nonvacuous for sign-changing X even though the positive-level integrand retains the same form.

rationale: The translation faithfully preserves the probability-space setting, strict threshold indicator, positive-level integration, order interchange, and extended-valued semantics of the selected Fubini-Tonelli equality. Its sole consequential difference is omission of the inherited nonnegativity hypothesis on X. This enlarges the theorem to nonvacuous sign-changing cases, so translation implies the source by specialization while the source does not imply the broader translation under the fixed applicability policy.
